purpose: Anchor #security. Server-rendered static section: header and a 940px bordered 2x2 matrix of four quadrants (icon box, index, title, body, mono proof line). Only motion is a hover wash (pointer:fine devices). Single column at <=720px.

budgetBasis.rule: maxWords = clone word count + max(1, ceil(25%)). cloneChars is the clone's own character count; originalChars (where present) is the measured character count of the live original's text role (length only, no copy).
budgetBasis.wordCount: whitespace tokens containing at least one alphanumeric character

motion.triggerNotes: No JS motion and no entrance. Hover (hover:hover and pointer:fine only): quadrant bg white 1.8%, icon border/fill brighten, 220ms ease.
motion.reducedMotionDetail: prefers-reduced-motion sets transition none on the quadrant and icon box.

responsive.change: 2x2 grid becomes one column; matrix radius 16 -> 14; quadrant padding clamp(28px,3vw,36px) -> 26px 24px, min-height auto; right border removed, last bottom border removed.
Hover wash only on fine-pointer hover devices.

example.title: AI your network can trust.
example.lede: Guardrails for real production work, so your team can hand tasks to AI with calm.

quadrants.title: Policy-bound AI
quadrants.body: Each action an agent takes is checked against your policies, and pauses for sign-off wherever you ask.
quadrants.proof: maintenance windows · sign-off flows · scoped edits

quadrants.title: Encrypted end to end
quadrants.body: Traffic and stored records are encrypted with modern, audited ciphers. Nothing ever sits in plain text.
quadrants.proof: TLS 1.2+ on the edge · mTLS inside · AES-256 disks

quadrants.title: Your data only
quadrants.body: Model vendors keep none of your subscriber records and never train on them. Ownership stays with you.
quadrants.proof: no retention · never used for model training

quadrants.title: Tenant separation
quadrants.body: Each customer runs in its own sealed environment with minimal access, and every action is logged.
quadrants.proof: sealed tenants · SSO and SCIM · append-only log
